headline_hook: Claude Ships a Security Stack, Google Drops Multimodal Embeddings, and a CVE Exposes the Entire AI Infra
preview_topics: Google's unified embedding space for text, images, and video
the zero-auth CVE haunting every FastAPI-based AI server

pick_of_the_day.thesis: CVE-2026-48710 is the wake-up call the AI infrastructure community has been ignoring — while we debate theoretical alignment risks, the actual stack running production AI (FastAPI, vLLM, LiteLLM, MCP servers) is sitting on the open internet with zero authentication, and Anthropic's same-day security blitz reads like they already knew.

model_literacy.concept: Zero Trust Architecture for AI Agents
model_literacy.relevance: Today's newsletter features both Anthropic's zero-trust agent framework and a CVE proving that perimeter-based security has already failed for AI infrastructure — understanding zero trust (verify every request, assume breach, least-privilege access) is now table stakes for anyone deploying agents or MCP servers.

items.title: Claude Marketplace Opens: Spend Commitments Now Buy Third-Party Claude Apps
items.angle: Anthropic turns its enterprise contracts into a platform moat — existing spend commitments now flow to Augment, CodeRabbit, Hebbia, and more, locking in the ecosystem.
items.key_fact: Launch partners include Augment, Bolt, CodeRabbit, Hebbia, and Legora

items.title: Gemini Embedding 2: One Model for Text, Images, and Video
items.angle: Google DeepMind ships a single embedding model that handles text, images, and video in one space — every RAG pipeline and multimodal search system just got a drop-in upgrade path.
items.key_fact: Native multimodal: text + image + video in a single embedding space

items.title: RF-DETR Lands in HuggingFace Transformers, Outguns YOLO
items.angle: State-of-the-art real-time detection and segmentation is now a pip install away — and it beats YOLO variants on both tasks.
items.key_fact: SOTA on both real-time detection and segmentation benchmarks

items.title: Android AppFunctions API: Your App Is Now an MCP Server for Gemini
items.angle: Google takes MCP mobile-native — any Android app can expose functions to Gemini and other on-device assistants via a Jetpack library.
items.key_fact: Jetpack library turns any Android app into an on-device MCP server

items.title: Claude Code Ships a Real-Time Security Scanner — 16K Likes in Hours
items.angle: Shift-left security for AI-assisted coding is here — the plugin catches vulnerabilities as you write code, not after you ship it. The 16K-like reception says this was overdue.
items.key_fact: 15,995 likes and 1,482 RTs — highest-engagement Claude Code announcement this month

items.title: OpenAI Enables Private MCP Servers via Outbound-Only HTTPS
items.angle: Teams can now keep MCP servers behind their firewall while still connecting to ChatGPT, Codex, and the Responses API — the security model enterprise IT has been waiting for.
items.key_fact: Outbound-only HTTPS means no inbound ports, no public exposure

items.title: Claude Code Gets a Reliability and Responsiveness Overhaul
items.angle: Infrastructure work that compounds for every active user daily — the kind of improvement you feel more than you read about.
items.key_fact: Wave of reliability and responsiveness improvements across Claude Code

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.152: /code-review --fix Applies Findings to Your Working Tree
items.angle: The --fix flag turns code review from a read-only report into an automated fixer — review findings go straight into your working tree.
items.key_fact: New: /code-review --fix, /simplify, disallowed-tools in skill frontmatter

items.title: Anthropic's Playbook: Using LLMs to Find Your Vulnerabilities Before Attackers Do
items.angle: A practical guide from Anthropic on weaponizing LLMs for defensive security — the companion piece to today's zero-trust framework and security plugin.
items.key_fact: Covers static analysis augmentation, vulnerability pattern detection, and security review workflows

items.title: Zero Trust for AI Agents: Trust Boundaries and Credential Management
items.angle: Anthropic extends its security framework from containment to trust — every agent action should be verified, every credential scoped, every boundary explicit.
items.key_fact: Applies Zero Trust principles specifically to agentic AI credential management

items.title: Delta Weight Sync: Ship Trillion-Parameter Models Without Shipping Trillions of Parameters
items.angle: HuggingFace's TRL now syncs only weight deltas during training — a simple idea that slashes storage and bandwidth for large-scale fine-tuning.
items.key_fact: Only syncs weight changes instead of full checkpoints

items.title: Diffusion-Inspired Training: Breaking Networks Into Independently Trainable Blocks
items.angle: If the forward pass can be treated like diffusion denoising, training blocks become independent — which could shatter the GPU memory wall that currently makes frontier training a billionaires-only game.
items.key_fact: Treats the forward pass as a diffusion denoising process to enable block-independent training

items.title: BadHost CVE-2026-48710: Clinical Trial Databases and MCP Servers Found Wide Open
items.angle: Researchers scanned the internet for one CVE and found the entire AI infrastructure stack — vLLM, LiteLLM, MCP servers, PII APIs — exposed with zero authentication.
items.key_fact: Clinical trial databases, email mailboxes, and PII APIs accessible with zero auth

items.title: ESMFold2: SOTA Protein Structure From Single Sequences, No MSA Required
items.angle: The bitter lesson hits protein biology — more compute and data beats hand-crafted evolutionary features for structure prediction.
items.key_fact: Achieves SOTA without multiple sequence alignment (MSA)

items.title: OpenAI Sunsets GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.3-Codex on June 2 — 5 Days to Migrate
items.angle: If your workflows are pinned to these models, the clock is ticking — OpenAI is simplifying its compute fleet and you have until Monday.
items.key_fact: June 2nd sunset date — 5 days from today

items.title: SynthID Crosses 100B Watermarks as OpenAI and ElevenLabs Join the Standard
items.angle: AI content watermarking just went from Google's solo project to an industry standard — with OpenAI, ElevenLabs, and Kakao on board, the 'was this AI-generated' question gets a real answer.
items.key_fact: 100B+ pieces of content watermarked; OpenAI, ElevenLabs, and Kakao now adopting

items.title: Simon Willison: Anthropic and OpenAI Have Crossed the Product-Market Fit Line
items.angle: The token economy has shifted from experimental budget to required line item — Willison argues we've passed the point of no return for AI spend.
items.key_fact: AI tokens are now a required budget line item, not an experimental one

items.title: Code w/ Claude London: How Teams Are Restructuring Around AI Agents
items.angle: Anthropic's London event reveals how early-adopter teams are actually reorganizing their development workflows — not just adding AI tools, but changing team structure.
items.key_fact: Recap from Anthropic's London developer event on AI-native workflows

items.title: CodeRabbit's Claude-Powered Agent Orchestration: A Production Multi-Agent Case Study
items.angle: How a company processing millions of code reviews built their multi-agent orchestration layer on Claude — real architecture decisions, not a toy demo.
items.key_fact: Production system handling millions of code reviews via multi-agent orchestration

items.title: Self-Improving Tax Agents: When Codex Learns From Its Own Mistakes
items.angle: The feedback loop is the real story — human reviewers fix errors, Codex traces the failure, and the workflow improves itself. A pattern worth stealing.
items.key_fact: Error traces from human reviewers feed back into automated workflow improvement
